title: Coeur to Participate in the RBC Capital Markets Global Mining & Materials Conference
summary: Coeur Mining, Inc.’s (“Coeur” or the “Company”) (NYSE, TSX: CDE) Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer, Mitchell J. Krebs, and Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, Thomas S. Whelan, will participate in the RBC Capital Markets Global Mining Materials Conference in New York, New York on Thursday, June 11, 2026. The RBC Capital Markets Global Mining Materials Conference is an invitation-only investment conference. Presentation materials will be made available on the Company’s website at www.coeur.com . About Coeur Coeur Mining, Inc. is a U.S.-based, well-diversified, growing precious metals producer with seven wholly-owned operations: the New Afton gold-copper mine in British Columbia, Canada, the Rainy River gold-silver mine in Ontario, Canada, the Las Chispas silver-gold mine in Sonora, Mexico, the Palmarejo gold-silver mine in Chihuahua, Mexico, the Rochester silver-gold mine in Nevada, the Kensington gold mine in Alaska and the Wharf gold mine
